items.title: Show HN: Nub – A Bun-like all-in-one toolkit for Node.js
items.author: colinmcd
items.rawContent:
Colin here, creator of Nub. I’ve had the general shape of this in mind for years. Nub runs your code with stock `node`, augmented with a `--require` preload hook[0] that adds a transpiler (oxc-powered, packaged as a Node-API add-on), registers a module resolution hook[1], and injects polyfills as needed for APIs like `Worker`, `Temporal`, etc. All purely additive, your code ultimately runs using Node’s actual engine & stdlib implementations.

[0]
items.summary: Nub 是一个面向 Node.js 的一体化开发工具包，类似 Bun，但基于原生 Node.js 运行时，通过 `--require` 预加载机制集成 OXC 转译器、模块解析钩子和现代 Web API（如 Worker、Temporal）的 polyfill。
items.summaryEn: Nub is a Bun-like all-in-one toolkit for Node.js that enhances stock Node.js (not replacing it) with an OXC-powered transpiler, custom module resolution, and polyfills for modern APIs—via a `--require` preload hook.
items.titleEn: Show HN: Nub – A Bun-like all-in-one toolkit for Node.js

The book opens with the LLM substrate -- transformer architecture, GPU systems, training and fine-tuning (SFT,LoRA, MoE), model compression, and inference optimization -- t

items.title: Improved Large Language Diffusion Models
items.author: Shen Nie
items.rawContent: Modern large language models are predominantly trained with autoregressive factorization and causal attention. We present iLLaDA, an 8B masked diffusion language model trained from scratch with fully bidirectional attention. iLLaDA keeps the masked diffusion objective throughout pre-training and supervised fine-tuning (SFT), scaling pre-training to 12T tokens and fine-tuning on a 25B-token instruction corpus for 12 epochs. We further use variable-length generation for efficiency and introduce co
items.summary: 本文提出iLLaDA——一种从零训练的80亿参数掩码扩散式大语言模型，采用全双向注意力机制，并在预训练和监督微调中全程保持掩码扩散目标，显著区别于主流自回归范式。
items.summaryEn: This paper introduces iLLaDA, an 8B-parameter masked diffusion language model trained from scratch with fully bidirectional attention—maintaining the masked diffusion objective throughout both pre-training (12T tokens) and supervised fine-tuning (25B-token instruction corpus, 12 epochs)—challenging the dominant autoregressive paradigm.
items.titleEn: Improved Large Language Diffusion Models
